title: GPT Image joins the image model list
summary:
GPT Image joined the model list, six community projects joined the showcase, and the text API cache worker got a closer look.

Added `gptimage` with a 1024-pixel maximum side length and JPEG output. Requests now return clearer authorization and generation errors instead of silently falling back to another model.

The project lists gained a YouTube Shorts generator that pairs Pollinations visuals with scripts and voiceovers, a jigsaw game that draws from the Pollinations feed, and a novel-writing app that works from story context.

Three more projects joined the lists: FoldaScan for codebase questions, Pollin-Coder for generating website content and layouts, and PolliBot for using image and text models through Telegram.

daily.title: GPT Image added
daily.text: Generate JPEG images with `gptimage`, up to 1024 pixels on the longest side. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gptimage).
